regimeSub: Oil crashes on Trump Iran de-escalation hints while Oct NFP 165K beat cements Dec hike as tech rout deepens.
themes: Oct NFP beats at 165K vs ~120K est per Bloomberg/CNBC; unemployment falls to 4.1% → Dec hike locked in with Fed rate at 4%, 2Y falls 12bp to 4.46%
Brent drops to $98.40 as Trump says Iran attacks 'unlikely' per Reuters; biggest weekly drop since 2020 per Bloomberg → geopolitical risk premium unwinds
Fed's Hammack/Barkin Nov 5 gradual hike rhetoric still dominates; CPI due this week per FT → Warsh Dec hike narrative intact despite rate-sensitive selloff
SOX crashes 'second-worst day on record' per 24/7 Wall St; KOSPI stabilizes at 5107 after $1T AI wipeout → Samsung/SK Hynix margin-call reprieve per BigGo

headline: Strong Oct payrolls cement Dec Fed hike as Trump Iran de-escalation signal triggers oil crash while tech rout extends into second week.
